story: User can select and configure their preferred AI provider
story_description: As a user, I want my preferred provider and model selection to be remembered across app restarts so I do not have to reconfigure my preferences each time I launch Blaze.
task_description: Store user provider and model preferences in UserDefaults with support for directory-based hints and migration from previous formats.
atom_description: Implement UserDefaults-based storage for last-used provider and model selections, with directory hint detection that overrides stored preferences when CLI config directories are present.
problem_statement: Users must manually select their preferred provider every time they open the New Session modal. This creates friction for users who consistently use the same provider. Additionally, when opening a session in a directory that already has provider-specific configuration files, the modal should intelligently default to the matching provider.
scope_in: Store last-used provider identifier in UserDefaults under key blazeLastUsedProvider
Store last-used model identifier in UserDefaults under key blazeLastUsedModel
Auto-select last-used provider and model when New Session modal opens
Detect directory hints by checking for .claude/, .gemini/, or .codex/ directories
Directory hint takes precedence over UserDefaults stored preference
Provide reset method to clear stored preferences
Handle migration if UserDefaults keys change in future versions
scope_out: Per-project provider overrides stored in project-specific config files
Syncing preferences across multiple Macs via iCloud
Storing provider API keys or tokens
assumptions: UserDefaults is available and writable in the app sandbox
Provider identifiers are stable string enums that will not change frequently
Directory hint detection runs synchronously and completes within 50ms
The New Session modal has access to the selected directory path before displaying
constraints: Must use UserDefaults standard suite for simplicity and reliability
Must not store sensitive data like API keys in UserDefaults
Directory hint detection must not block UI thread for more than 100ms
Must handle UserDefaults read failures gracefully with fallback to Anthropic default
Must be compatible with macOS 14.0 Sonoma and later
functional_requirements: FR1: When user selects a provider in New Session modal and creates a session, persist the provider identifier to UserDefaults key blazeLastUsedProvider
FR2: When user selects a model in New Session modal and creates a session, persist the model identifier to UserDefaults key blazeLastUsedModel
FR3: When New Session modal opens, read blazeLastUsedProvider from UserDefaults and pre-select that provider if valid
FR4: When New Session modal opens, read blazeLastUsedModel from UserDefaults and pre-select that model if valid and available for the selected provider
FR5: When a directory path is provided to New Session modal, check for .claude/, .gemini/, or .codex/ subdirectories
FR6: If directory hint is detected, override UserDefaults preference with detected provider: .claude/ maps to anthropic, .gemini/ maps to google, .codex/ maps to openai
FR7: Provide AppSettings.resetProviderDefaults() method to clear all provider preference keys
FR8: If UserDefaults read returns nil or invalid value, default to anthropic provider and claude-sonnet-4-20250514 model
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: UserDefaults read and write operations complete within 10ms
NFR2: Directory hint detection completes within 50ms for typical project directories
NFR3: Provider preference persistence survives app termination, crash, and system restart
NFR4: Code follows Swift naming conventions and Blaze project code style
implementation_steps: Step 1: Add UserDefaults keys as static constants in AppSettings.swift - blazeLastUsedProvider and blazeLastUsedModel
Step 2: Add computed properties in AppSettings for lastUsedProvider and lastUsedModel that read from UserDefaults with fallback defaults
Step 3: Add setLastUsedProvider(provider:) and setLastUsedModel(model:) methods in AppSettings that write to UserDefaults
Step 4: Add resetProviderDefaults() method in AppSettings that removes both keys from UserDefaults
Step 5: Add detectDirectoryHint(at path:) method in AppSettings that checks for .claude/, .gemini/, .codex/ directories and returns optional ProviderIdentifier
Step 6: Modify NewSessionModal.swift to call AppSettings.shared.lastUsedProvider on appear and set initial selection
Step 7: Modify NewSessionModal.swift to call detectDirectoryHint if directory path is available and override provider selection
Step 8: Modify NewSessionModal.swift to call setLastUsedProvider and setLastUsedModel when user confirms session creation
Step 9: Add unit tests for AppSettings provider defaults methods
Step 10: Add unit tests for directory hint detection with mock file system
data_model_changes: Add UserDefaults key constant: static let lastUsedProviderKey = blazeLastUsedProvider
Add UserDefaults key constant: static let lastUsedModelKey = blazeLastUsedModel
Add ProviderIdentifier enum case mapping for directory hints: anthropic, google, openai
api_contracts: AppSettings.shared.lastUsedProvider: ProviderIdentifier - computed property returning stored provider or .anthropic default
AppSettings.shared.lastUsedModel: String - computed property returning stored model ID or claude-sonnet-4-20250514 default
AppSettings.shared.setLastUsedProvider(_ provider: ProviderIdentifier) -> Void - persists provider to UserDefaults
AppSettings.shared.setLastUsedModel(_ modelId: String) -> Void - persists model ID to UserDefaults
AppSettings.shared.resetProviderDefaults() -> Void - removes both keys from UserDefaults
AppSettings.shared.detectDirectoryHint(at path: URL) -> ProviderIdentifier? - returns provider if hint directory found, nil otherwise
event_contracts: No events emitted - this is pure persistence logic without observable side effects
ui_states: New Session modal opens with provider dropdown pre-selected to last-used provider
New Session modal opens with model dropdown pre-selected to last-used model for that provider
New Session modal opens with directory-hint provider selected when hint directory detected
New Session modal opens with default Anthropic provider when no stored preference exists
ui_interactions: User opens New Session modal and sees their last-used provider pre-selected
User changes provider selection which will be persisted on session creation
User creates session which triggers persistence of current provider and model selections
User with directory containing .claude/ opens New Session and sees Anthropic pre-selected regardless of stored preference
ui_copy: No new user-visible strings - provider names already defined in ProviderIdentifier enum displayName property
edge_cases: UserDefaults returns nil for both keys on fresh install - default to Anthropic and claude-sonnet-4-20250514
UserDefaults contains invalid provider string that does not match any ProviderIdentifier case - fall back to Anthropic default
UserDefaults contains valid provider but model ID not available for that provider - use provider default model
Directory contains multiple hint directories like both .claude/ and .gemini/ - use priority order: .claude/ > .gemini/ > .codex/
Directory path is nil or invalid URL - skip directory hint detection entirely
UserDefaults is locked or corrupted - catch exception and use defaults without persisting
Directory hint directory exists but is a file not a directory - treat as no hint
failure_modes: UserDefaults write fails silently - preference not persisted but app continues with in-memory selection, logs warning
Directory hint detection throws file system error - caught and treated as no hint found, logs warning
AppSettings.shared accessed before app initialization complete - ensure initialization order in BlazeApp lifecycle
Corrupted UserDefaults plist - system handles recovery, app uses defaults
rollback_plan: Remove the lastUsedProvider and lastUsedModel computed properties and persistence methods from AppSettings.swift. Remove the onAppear preference loading and onSubmit preference saving from NewSessionModal.swift. Delete the detectDirectoryHint method. Run swift build to verify clean compilation. UserDefaults keys can remain orphaned without harm.

risks: UserDefaults corruption could cause app to fail on launch if not handled
Directory hint detection could be slow on network-mounted directories
Storing provider preference could expose user workflow patterns if UserDefaults exported
mitigations: Wrap all UserDefaults reads in try-catch with fallback to defaults
Add 100ms timeout to directory hint detection with fallback to no hint
Store only provider/model identifiers, not usage patterns or timestamps
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects NewSessionModal provider selection only - no impact on session execution, CLI invocation, or data persistence layers
risk_register.fallback_plan: If persistence causes issues, disable by returning hardcoded defaults from computed properties. UserDefaults keys remain but are ignored.

provider_default_saved telemetry event emitted on session creation
state: AppSettings singleton holds no in-memory provider state - always reads from UserDefaults
NewSessionModal @State selectedProvider initialized from AppSettings on appear
persistence: UserDefaults key blazeLastUsedProvider stores String value of ProviderIdentifier rawValue
UserDefaults key blazeLastUsedModel stores String value of model identifier
